description:
Hushfeed v0.36.0 targets global TikTok 46.2.3 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

Playback quality now reaches the player. The setting picked a gear out of the video model's own list and reported it, but TikTok's player builds its models from a different list the patch left alone, so every video still played at whatever quality the player chose. The choice is now made where the player reads its list, and the diagnostic report names that spot. Every patch applies on TikTok 46.9.3 as well: fourteen used to fail there because that build marks methods final and stops merging small lambdas into shared classes, and the patches now find their targets by what the code does. The gate report dialog keeps its report open after Copy, saved reports are named by date under Download/Hushfeed, a session hold stops its timer while the app is in the background, and settings rows keep their drawables when the list rebinds them.

Validation: 1372 runtime tests passed locally, plus 215 in the patches module. The bundle carries 81 patches and all three DEX payloads are non-empty. Both Android API checks passed. All patches applied with zero failures to the 46.2.3, 46.7.3, 46.8.3 and 46.9.3 fixtures. Needs Morphe Manager 1.30.0 or newer.

The downloadable .mpp is the patch bundle. Patch on the device with Morphe Manager and keep its existing signing key.
